message.content:
The root cause of the syntax error is a missing backslash to escape the quote inside the string: `print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity after deduplication:\")` contains a quote that is not escaped, causing Python to interpret it as the end of the string.

To fix it, escape the internal quote with a backslash: `print("\\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity after deduplication:\\")`.

Now, proceed to resolve the remaining findings.
